description: This file defines the LLM_Agentflow class implementing an LNode interface, managing interactions with large language models, including message handling, memory management, streaming responses, and artifact extraction within a flow-based system.

classes.name: LLM_Agentflow
classes.description: A class implementing an LNode for managing large language model interactions, including message processing, memory management, streaming, and artifact handling.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains methods to list models and runtime state keys for dynamic loading.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method to process input, manage memory, invoke LLM, handle streaming, artifacts, and produce output.

methods.name: handleMemory
methods.description: Manages conversation memory based on selected memory type (window, summary, buffer).

methods.name: handleSummaryBuffer
methods.description: Summarizes messages exceeding token limit to maintain buffer size.

methods.name: handleStreamingResponse
methods.description: Handles streaming responses from the LLM, streaming tokens via SSE.

methods.name: prepareOutputObject
methods.description: Prepares the final output object with response content and metadata.

methods.name: sendStreamingEvents
methods.description: Streams additional events like tool calls and metadata via SSE.
